calendar.title: Ted's Reykjavik
calendar.byline: Curated by Ted · things I’d actually go to
calendar.description: Real Reykjavik this week: Harpa concerts, harbour whales, geothermal lagoons, midnight-sun tours. Hand-picked, no filler.

events.title: Sky Lagoon
events.blurb: Oceanside geothermal lagoon with a 75-m infinity edge over the North Atlantic and the 7-step Skjól ritual (cold plunge, sauna with sea view, body scrub). Summer hours (Jun 21–Aug 20): daily 08:00–23:00. Saman pass from 14.990 kr, Sér from 17.990 kr. ~15 min from downtown.

events.title: Elding Classic Whale Watching
events.blurb: Reykjavik's original whale-watching operator sails Faxaflói bay hunting minkes, humpbacks, dolphins and porpoises. 2.5–3.5 hrs. July departures daily at 09:00, 11:00, 13:00, 15:00, 17:00 and 20:30 from the Old Harbour.

events.title: Perlan — Wonders of Iceland, Ice Cave & Áróra Planetarium
events.blurb: Nature exploratorium in the glass dome on Öskjuhlíð hill — exhibitions open daily 9:00–21:00. Walk through a real indoor ice cave, watch Áróra (8K northern-lights planetarium show), the Geldingadalir volcano show, the Látrabjarg bird-cliff model, and take in the 360° observation deck over Reykjavík.

events.title: National Museum of Iceland — Making of a Nation
events.blurb: Iceland's national history museum, open daily 10:00–17:00. Permanent exhibition 'Making of a Nation: Heritage and History in Iceland' plus current shows 'A Voyage in History – The Bridal Costume' and 'FLOW – Sólon Íslandus & Mógil' (both running through the window). Students/seniors 1600 ISK, under 18 free.

events.title: Whales of Iceland
events.blurb: Europe's largest whale museum: 23 life-sized models of the whales found in Icelandic waters, with audio guide. Open daily 10:00–17:00; live guided tours daily at 11:00 and 15:00. Kids 7–15 2000 ISK, under 7 free.

events.title: Erró: Remix & Karin Sander: 1957-2057 at Hafnarhús
events.blurb: The old harbour warehouse branch of Reykjavík Art Museum shows 'Erró: Remix — including a selection of Scapes' (the Icelandic pop-art giant) and German conceptual artist 'Karin Sander: 1957–2057'. Open 10:00–17:00, Thursday late night until 22:00 (Jul 30).

events.title: Viðey Island Ferry
events.blurb: Five-minute hop to peaceful Viðey island — hiking, birdlife, Yoko Ono's Imagine Peace Tower and Viðeyjarstofa café. Summer ferries hourly from Skarfabakki 10:15–17:15 daily, plus Old Harbour departures at 11:50 and 14:50 (return ticket).

events.title: Free Walking Tour Reykjavik (CityWalk)
events.blurb: The famous 2-hour pay-what-you-want walk through downtown Reykjavik — Harpa, Parliament, City Hall, rainbow street — with history, elves and economic collapse told with a wink. Departs every day (booking calendar lists 10:30 and 13:30 slots); ends at City Hall.

events.title: The Reykjavik Food Walk
events.blurb: Wake Up Reykjavik's #1-rated food tour: 3 hours, 5 local restaurants, 8+ tastes from lamb soup to Icelandic hot dogs with a local foodie guide. Runs every day with multiple departure times to choose from at booking (exact slots vary — the noon start here is nominal).

events.title: Múlinn Jazz Club: Sigurður Flosason Quartet
events.blurb: The Sigurður Flosason Quartet plays groovy jazz-blues at Múlinn Jazz Club in Harpa's top-floor Björtuloft hall — sax, Hammond organ, guitar and drums from veterans of the Icelandic jazz scene.

events.title: Ástin sem eftir er / The Love That Remains (English subtitles) at Bíó Paradís
events.blurb: Hlynur Pálmason's acclaimed Icelandic feature 'Ástin sem eftir er' (The Love That Remains) with English subtitles, Wed 29 Jul at 16:40. Also Wed with ENG subs: Jafar Panahi's Cannes winner 'It Was Just an Accident' at 18:50.

events.title: David Byrne in Eldborg
events.blurb: Talking Heads legend David Byrne plays Harpa's flagship Eldborg hall (Sena Live). Doors 19:30; most seating tiers already sold out — only A and Gold seats remain.

events.title: How to Become Icelandic in 60 Minutes
events.blurb: Long-running one-man comedy show in English: learn to walk, talk and behave like a regular Icelander in one hour. A hilarious blend of stand-up and theater in Harpa's Kaldalón hall.

events.title: Petals & Friends Quartet at Mengi
events.blurb: Intimate show at Mengi, Reykjavík's longest-running independent venue for creative and experimental music, on Óðinsgata just off Skólavörðustígur.
